season.title: Season 1: The Shadow Protocol
season.logline: A disappeared intelligence archive pulls a disgraced operative back into a conspiracy that reaches from Harare's freight yards to a private estate on Kaguvi Hill.
season.disclaimer: This is a work of fiction. All organisations, units and named individuals are invented. Real places are used only as recognisable geography and are not intended to depict real institutions or people.

characters.name: Kuda Moyo
characters.bio: Former Directorate operative. Left the service after Operation Ironwood went wrong. Disciplined, observant, dryly funny, and not entirely sure he is a good man.

characters.name: Nyasha Chikore
characters.bio: Kuda's former handler and the analyst who built the Shadow Protocol archive. She has been running from her own service for eight months.

characters.name: Tariro Mupfumi
characters.bio: Investigative reporter for The Harare Ledger. Believes public sunlight is the only reliable disinfectant. Has the scars to prove she has been wrong before.

characters.name: Mukoma Simba
characters.bio: Former soldier turned fixer. Runs a garage in Mbare and knows every road out of Harare. Loyal to people, not institutions.

characters.name: Rudo Ndlovu
characters.bio: Field medic and NGO courier. Keeps a clinic running in Mbare with donated supplies and inconvenient questions.

characters.name: Tendai Chuma
characters.bio: Nightjar contract driver. Not ideological. Mostly scared. He has a younger sister in Kuwadzana and a mother who thinks he works in logistics.

characters.name: Farai 'Fingers' Nyandoro
characters.bio: Money launderer and bureau de change operator. Quick hands, weak nerves, an encyclopaedic memory for account numbers.

characters.name: Captain Dereck Mhofu
characters.bio: Nightjar field commander at Kaguvi Hill. Professional, unhurried, and increasingly aware that his employer is not protecting the country he served.

characters.name: Brigadier-General Farai Gumbo
characters.bio: Founder of Nightjar Strategic Solutions and patron of the Shadow Protocol. Believes the state is too fragile for democracy and too important to leave to politicians.

characters.name: Collin Mavhunga
characters.bio: Deputy Director of the Directorate. The man who authorised Ironwood and sold its results. Calm, procedural, and utterly certain of his own necessity.

characters.name: Rutendo Chiweshe
characters.bio: Permanent Secretary in the Ministry of Interior. Provides political cover for Nightjar in exchange for plausible deniability.

characters.name: Blessing
characters.bio: Msasa dockworker. Owes Mukoma a favour and has a highly developed instinct for when to be elsewhere.

characters.name: Amai Grace
characters.bio: Mbare market elder. Sees everything, sells most of what she sees, and protects the rest.

factions.name: Nightjar Strategic Solutions
factions.description: A deniable security contractor with a client list that includes the Directorate. Runs the Shadow Protocol's protective layer.

factions.name: Directorate of Strategic Intelligence
factions.description: A fictional Zimbabwean intelligence body. Publicly restrained, internally divided, and penetrated by the Shadow Protocol.

factions.name: Civic Front
factions.description: A loose alliance of journalists, lawyers, medics and civil-society groups. Has no guns and considerable patience.

factions.name: The Ledger
factions.description: A money-laundering network built around bureaux de change, freight companies and a few very quiet accountants.
